prompt.description: What the image shows, in full: subject, style, composition, colors and any text in it

file_path.description: Absolute path of the output file inside the session's folders, with an image extension or none

size.description: WIDTHxHEIGHT such as 1024x1024 or 1536x1024; leave out for the model's default

count.description: How many images to make (default 1); several are saved as name-1, name-2 and so on

input_images.description: Absolute paths of PNG, JPEG or WebP images inside the session's folders to edit or use as references

quality.description: Rendering quality, where the model has the setting

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file at file_path (default false: an existing file is an error)

description.description: A short label of what this call makes, shown to the user as its row: a noun phrase of 2 to 6 words, no leading verb
